description: Radar stories of the last 48 hours: the same event at different outlets is matched by shared word stems, then each pair of outlets is scored with the Dice similarity of their headlines and by rare words they share. Verdicts collecting, no_copy_like_pairs, some_copy_like, many_copy_like, with examples naming the earlier and the later outlet. A flag to count two reports as one source, never a verdict on who copied. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Lee R. Dice (1887-1977).
name: get_dice
title: Dice sensor: do headlines of different outlets on one event look like one copied text
